title: Creator's Core
description: This modpack makes Minecraft better by strippping away misaligned features and makes Minecraft cohesive!
body:
# What is Creator's Core?
This is a modpack that focuses on progression, immersion, good game design, preventing unnecessary grind and creative problem solving with building

# Progression Changes
### Flint Tier 
- replaces wooden tools
- they stay relevant longer than wooden tools
- they are a little harder to acquire
### Copper Tier
- replaces stone tools
- they are a little harder to acquire than stone tools
### Iron Tier
- can no longer mine diamonds 
### Gold Tier
- can mine itself now 
### Rose Gold Tier
- is an alloy of lapis, gold and amethyst shard
- rose gold is required to mine diamond
### Diamond Tier
- the best tier in the game 


# Overall Features
This modpack is still in wip but there are some features that are implemented so I will list very notable changes. 

- There are custom tools! A big poriton of them imitate vanilla tools but I will add new tools later down the line but for now there are custom tool tiers and these tiers affect which ores you can mine. For example in order to mine a deepslate version of the ore block you'll need a higher tier! This feature will be expanded upon when I bother to update the mod betterharvestlevel haha.
- There is a new tool tier called rose gold it is in between iron and diamond and it is required to mine diamond etc
- Over 4000+ custom recipes!
- food is scarce like it really is most passive mobs only have a %1 chance of spawning (but sometimes it gets broken and I need to investigate it!)
- Creepers don't spawn everywhere they spawn only in deepslate caves and forest biomes (some caves are marked as forest biomes and frankly I can't do much about that!)
- There are new modded mobs to fight (none of them are integrated yet!)
- There is cascades worldgen mod to enchance the world generation to be more inspiring
- I almost removed every single recipe but don't worry I am adding them back with modifications to them! These modifications make building blocks way cheaper. Like normal Minecraft is just super grindy about building blocks for no reason in my opinion 
- You now need flint to make armor plates to make armor 
- wooden and stone tools are removed and they are instead replaced with flint and copper tools but you can still punch wood like that is okay 
- There are paint brushes now and instead of crafting painted blocks now you have to paint them with a paint brush instead for more immersion!
- I will modify some item stack sizes to help with the inventory bloat (currently the only affected item is the torch and it stacks to 1 yeah helping with the bloat there!) 
- No enchanting 
- No villagers 
- No structures 
- No End 
- No mob farms 
- No early game easy reliable food 
- (I need to test the removed features I don't know if it works as intended and there maybe more things that I removed that I forgot about)
- The diabolical islands mod changes the nether worldgen to be floating islands over the lava ocean (but the nether is not properly integrated yet!) 

# Credits
I only made a collection of mods and resource packs to this modpack. I didn't  make any of the mods or resource packs used here. This modpack wouldn't be possible without these amazing projects made by these amazing people! Please make sure to check them out!
